Good times and a great bar.
Sep 2025 • Family
The Down Under Bar in Dalat is a hidden gem that serves up top-notch Australian and Western cuisine as well as craft beer in a cozy and inviting atmosphere. The staff is super friendly and the service is always prompt.

Their menu is packed with delicious options, including mouth-watering burgers, tasty chicken parmigiana, awesome chicken kabobs and impressive Wagyu steaks. Don't even get me started on their amazing selection of Vietnamese craft beer!

Whether you're a local or just passing through, the Down Under Bar is a must-visit spot in Dalat. With its excellent food, great drinks, and welcoming vibe, you'll feel right at home. Highly recommend
